Maize then Beans: sequence recommended by IRAD
Beans then Potato: sequence recommended by IRAD
Beans before Potato: the legume enriches the soil with nitrogen
Potato then Groundnut: sequence recommended by IRAD
Potato in the 1st season: little ground cover, erosion risk (wettest season)
conseils: Acidic soil (pH 5.3): apply 5 to 10 t/ha of compost or manure and wood ash to raise the pH towards 5.5-6.5 (IRAD).
Groundnut: apply wood ash, it needs calcium on acidic soil (IRAD).
Maize, critical periods: flowering: critical water stress; grain filling: critical water stress, poorly filled cobs.
Beans, critical periods: flowering: sensitive to water shortage.
Potato, critical periods: tuber formation (day 40 to 70): needs regular water.
Groundnut, critical periods: up to day 60: needs regular water; end of cycle: too much water rots the pods.

normes_irad.jachere: Leave one season in three as fallow, with a cover crop (Mucuna or Stylosanthes).
normes_irad.association: Intercropping maize + beans or maize + groundnut is acceptable.
normes_irad.amendement: Apply 5 to 10 t/ha of compost or manure, plus wood ash, to raise the pH towards 5.5-6.5.
erreurs_a_eviter: Beans after beans: yield cut in half.
Cassava after cassava: dead soil and mealybugs.
Maize after maize without fertiliser: empty cobs.
